SQL:
SELECT
  customers__cities.size_class AS "orders.customers.cities.size_class",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN cities AS customers__cities
  ON customers.city = customers__cities.city
  AND customers.region_id = customers__cities.region_id
GROUP BY
  customers__cities.size_class
ORDER BY
  "orders.revenue" DESC
LIMIT 21

[{"orders.customers.cities.size_class": "large", "orders.revenue": 205080.27999999985}, {"orders.customers.cities.size_class": "medium", "orders.revenue": 100075.84000000003}, {"orders.customers.cities.size_class": "small", "orders.revenue": 26339.030000000002}, {"orders.customers.cities.size_class": null, "orders.revenue": 1193.3}]

args.message: Revenue by city size class: large 205,080.28, medium 100,075.84, small 26,339.03. Orders whose customer's city isn't in the reference table total 1,193.30 and are shown as null. Customers were matched to cities on both city name and region, because the same city name can appear in more than one region (Oslo is listed as large in region 1 and small in region 2).
